summary: Regression fix VERIFIED. The Register (Invitation only) screen now correctly shows the white-on-dark wordmark (logo-fourbuy.png) in BOTH themeMode='light' and themeMode='dark' — confirmed by inspecting the rendered src on both runs. The new `variant` prop on BrandLogo (default 'auto'; register passes variant='dark') successfully overrides the ThemeContext-driven variant selection so a persisted Day-mode preference no longer bleeds the dark-on-white logo onto the dark-locked register hero. Auto swap on non-locked screens still works: Home shows logo-fourbuy-light.png in Day mode and logo-fourbuy.png in Night mode. Login screen (raw ) remains on the dark logo in both modes. No side-effects observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor (unchanged from iter_26): makeStyles(colors) in BrandLogo.tsx still accepts a `colors` palette but the resulting stylesheet only references `alignItems/justifyContent`. The palette dependency is unused and causes an unnecessary re-memoization whenever the theme mode flips. Consider dropping the argument (or keeping it only if you plan to color the wrapper). Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing dealer minitest@example.com / Mini1234!.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Register logo regression fix confirmed working. Detection method: read the rendered inside [data-testid="brand-logo"].
